About BeautyFlow

BeautyFlow is where Kenya books beauty and wellness. We help people find salons, spas, barbers, nail studios and makeup artists near them, see real prices, and book a time — and we give those businesses the tools to run the day: bookings, a POS, staff commission and payslips.

For clients

  • See prices before you go — services, durations and prices published by the businesses themselves, with photos and reviews.
  • Book several services at once — add what you want to one booking, see the total and pick a time.
  • Search by service — knotless braids, locs, gel nails, lashes, facials, massage and more.
  • Find deals — mid-week discounts and packages from places across Kenya.

For salons, spas and barbershops

A free page that ranks for searches like “salons in Kilimani”, with online booking and verified reviews. On the Business plan: a POS where every service is tagged to the staff member who did it, commission worked out automatically, payouts with payslips, staff shifts, and reports on what really makes you money.

Our promise

We never take a cut of your sales and we never sell your data. Clients pay you directly. Every listing is checked by our team before it shows the Verified badge.
